strings.1. Adaptörü aracın OBD soketine tak (gen:
1. Plug the adapter into the car's OBD socket (usually below the steering wheel, on the left) and turn the ignition on.

Bluetooth: Nearby adapters are listed when you choose an adapter. Some adapters must be paired in the phone's Bluetooth settings first (like OBDII, ELM327, V-LINK; PIN is usually 1234 or 0000).

Wi-Fi: Connect the phone to the adapter's Wi-Fi network and stay connected when it warns "no internet"; the address is usually 192.168.0.10:35000.

Classic Bluetooth ELM327 is the best tested. Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi adapter support is experimental.

strings.• Sürüş sırasında uygulamayla uğraşma; a:
• Don't fiddle with the app while driving; change settings while parked.
• Values are read from the engine computer; fuel and alerts are estimates. The car's own gauges and warning lights come first.
• The app only sends read requests to the car. Write operations such as clearing fault codes happen only with your confirmation.
• The app is provided as is; the developer is not responsible for any consequences of its use.
strings.Sürüş kayıtları ve bildirimler telefonda: Driving logs and notifications never leave the phone. For the weather, an approximate location (about 100 m) is sent to Open-Meteo. Address search and navigation come from Yandex: during navigation your location, the address you search and your destination go to Yandex. Outside navigation the map comes from OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap). No ads, no tracking. A problem report goes only through the app you choose, to the person you choose. If the phone's Android backup is on, settings (including Home/Work addresses) may go to the Google backup. The update check asks GitHub once a day (can be turned off).

strings.• Uygulama her açılışta adaptöre kendili:
• The app connects to the adapter by itself every time it opens. Tap the signal bars in the top bar for the connection status.
• Long-press the value strip at the bottom to change which values are shown.
• The gear is learned in the first few minutes of driving; until then it may show "–".
• Fuel consumption is an estimate; correct it by entering fill-ups in Settings > Fuel.
